name: get_media_info
description: Get comprehensive media file information using ffprobe.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the media file

name: get_video_resolution
description: Get video resolution (width x height) and aspect ratio.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the video file

name: get_duration
description: Get the duration of a media file.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the media file

name: list_streams
description: List all streams (video, audio, subtitle, data) in a media file.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the media file

name: get_frame_count
description: Get the total number of frames in a video.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the video file

name: detect_scene_changes
description: Detect scene changes/cuts in a video file.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the video file

threshold.description: Scene change sensitivity (0.0-1.0, lower = more sensitive, default: 0.3)

name: get_keyframes
description: List all keyframe timestamps in a video.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the video file

name: convert_video
description: Convert a video file to another format with full codec control.

input_path.description: Path to the source video file

output_path.description: Path for the output file (format determined by extension)

video_codec.description: Video codec (libx264, libx265, libvpx-vp9, av1, copy, etc.)

audio_codec.description: Audio codec (aac, libmp3lame, libopus, copy, etc.)

video_bitrate.description: Video bitrate (e.g., "2M", "5000k"). If None, uses CRF.

preset.description: Encoding preset (ultrafast, superfast, veryfast, faster, fast, medium, slow, slower, veryslow)

crf.description: Constant Rate Factor quality (0-51 for x264, 0-63 for x265; lower = better quality)

extra_args.description: Additional FFmpeg arguments as a space-separated string

name: convert_audio
description: Convert an audio file to another format.

input_path.description: Path to the source audio file

output_path.description: Path for the output file (format determined by extension: .mp3, .aac, .wav, .flac, .ogg, etc.)

audio_codec.description: Audio codec (aac, libmp3lame, libopus, flac, pcm_s16le, etc.)

name: convert_to_gif
description: Convert a video (or part of it) to an animated GIF.

input_path.description: Path to the source video file

output_path.description: Path for the output GIF file

fps.description: Frames per second for the GIF

name: batch_convert
description: Batch convert all media files in a directory from one format to another.

name: extract_audio
description: Extract audio track from a video file.

input_path.description: Path to the source video file

output_path.description: Path for the extracted audio file (.mp3, .aac, .wav, .flac, etc.)

audio_codec.description: Audio codec (use "copy" for lossless extraction, or specify codec)

name: trim_video
description: Trim/cut a segment from a video file.

end_time.description: End time (e.g., "00:02:00" or "120"). Mutually exclusive with duration.

duration.description: Duration of the segment (e.g., "00:00:30" or "30"). Mutually exclusive with end_time.

name: merge_videos
description: Merge/concatenate multiple video files into one.

input_paths.description: Comma-separated list of input video file paths

method.description: Merge method ('concat_demuxer' for same codec files, 'concat_filter' for different codecs)

name: resize_video
description: Resize/scale a video to specific dimensions.

width.description: Target width in pixels (use -1 for auto based on height)

height.description: Target height in pixels (use -1 for auto based on width)

name: change_speed
description: Change the playback speed of a video.

speed_factor.description: Speed multiplier (0.5 = half speed, 2.0 = double speed, etc.)

adjust_audio.description: Whether to adjust audio speed/pitch to match

name: extract_frames
description: Extract frames from a video as image files.

fps.description: Frames per second to extract (None = all frames)

name: create_video_from_images
description: Create a video from a sequence of images.

name: rotate_video
description: Rotate a video by a specified angle.

angle.description: Rotation angle in degrees (90, 180, 270, or arbitrary)

name: crop_video
description: Crop a region from a video.

name: add_thumbnail
description: Add a thumbnail/poster image to a video file (MP4).

name: generate_thumbnail
description: Extract a single frame as a thumbnail image from a video.

time.description: Timestamp to extract the frame from

name: adjust_volume
description: Adjust audio volume of a media file.

volume.description:
Volume level - can be a factor (e.g., "2.0" for double),
    dB value (e.g., "3dB" or "-5dB"), or percentage

name: normalize_audio
description: Normalize audio loudness using EBU R128 standard (loudnorm filter).

name: mix_audio
description: Mix/overlay an audio track onto a video, or replace the video's audio.

audio_path.description: Path to the audio file to overlay

audio_delay.description: Delay in seconds before the audio starts

replace_audio.description: If True, replace original audio entirely; if False, mix together

name: remove_audio
description: Remove all audio tracks from a video file.

name: add_fade_audio
description: Add audio fade-in and/or fade-out effects.

fade_in.description: Fade-in duration in seconds (0 = no fade-in)

fade_out.description: Fade-out duration in seconds (0 = no fade-out)

name: generate_waveform
description: Generate a waveform visualization image from an audio file.

name: generate_spectrogram
description: Generate a spectrogram visualization image from an audio file.

name: add_text_overlay
description: Add text overlay/watermark to a video. Windows-safe (handles path escaping).

font_file.description:
Path to a .ttf font file. Optional.
Windows: "C:/Windows/Fonts/arialbd.ttf"
macOS:   "/Library/Fonts/Arial Bold.ttf"
Linux:   "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"

start_time.description: When to start showing text (seconds, None=from beginning)

end_time.description: When to stop showing text (seconds, None=until end)

box.description: Whether to add a background box behind text

name: add_image_overlay
description: Add an image overlay (watermark/logo) to a video.

overlay_path.description: Path to the overlay image (PNG with transparency recommended)

x.description: Horizontal position (e.g., "10", "W-w-10" for right side, "(W-w)/2" for center)

y.description: Vertical position (e.g., "10", "H-h-10" for bottom, "(H-h)/2" for center)

name: apply_video_filter
description: Apply a named FFmpeg video filter.

name: add_fade
description: Add video fade-in and/or fade-out effects.

fade_in_duration.description: Fade-in duration in seconds (0 = no fade-in)

fade_out_duration.description: Fade-out duration in seconds (0 = no fade-out)

name: picture_in_picture
description: Create a picture-in-picture effect with two videos.

pip_width.description: Width of the PiP video (height auto-calculated)

pip_x.description: Horizontal position of PiP (default: top-right corner)

pip_y.description: Vertical position of PiP (default: top-right corner)

name: side_by_side
description: Place two videos side by side (horizontally or vertically).

name: create_slideshow
description: Create a slideshow video from a list of images with transitions.

image_paths.description: Comma-separated list of image file paths

duration_per_image.description: How long each image is shown (seconds)

transition.description: Transition type (fade, wipeleft, wiperight, wipeup, wipedown, slideleft, slideright)

name: extract_subtitles
description: Extract subtitles from a video file.

input_path.description: Path to the video file containing subtitles

output_path.description: Path for the output subtitle file

stream_index.description: Subtitle stream index to extract (default: 0 = first)

name: burn_subtitles
description: Burn/hardcode subtitles into a video (permanently embedded).

primary_color.description: Override primary color (e.g., "&HFFFFFF" for white in ASS format)

name: add_subtitle_track
description: Add a subtitle track to a video as a soft subtitle (selectable by player).

output_path.description: Path for the output video (.mkv recommended for best subtitle support)

title.description: Human-readable title for the subtitle track

default.description: Whether this should be the default subtitle track

name: create_hls_stream
description: Create HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) segments from a video file.

segment_duration.description: Duration of each segment in seconds

name: create_dash_stream
description: Create DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP) segments from a video.

segment_duration.description: Duration of each segment in seconds

name: create_adaptive_hls
description: Create multi-bitrate adaptive HLS stream with multiple quality levels.

name: stream_to_rtmp
description: Stream a video file to an RTMP server (e.g., YouTube Live, Twitch).

name: two_pass_encode
description:
Perform two-pass video encoding for optimal bitrate distribution.
Results in better quality than single-pass at the same bitrate.

name: stabilize_video
description: Stabilize shaky video using the vidstab filter (two-pass).

shakiness.description: How shaky the input is (1-10, default: 5)

accuracy.description: Detection accuracy (1-15, higher = slower but better, default: 15)

smoothing.description: Number of frames for smoothing (larger = smoother but less responsive, default: 10)

name: denoise_video
description: Apply video noise reduction.

method.description: Denoise method ("hqdn3d" for fast, "nlmeans" for high quality)

name: deinterlace_video
description: Deinterlace a video (convert interlaced to progressive).

method.description: Deinterlace method ("yadif" for fast, "bwdif" for better quality, "w3fdif" for high quality)

name: change_framerate
description: Change the frame rate of a video.

method.description: Method ("fps" for simple, "minterpolate" for motion-interpolated smooth conversion)

name: compress_video
description: Compress a video to reduce file size. Either specify a target size or use CRF.

target_size_mb.description: Target file size in MB (calculates optimal bitrate). If None, uses CRF.

crf.description: Constant Rate Factor (higher = smaller file, lower quality; 18-28 recommended)

name: add_metadata
description: Add or modify metadata tags in a media file.

name: remove_metadata
description: Strip all metadata from a media file.

name: run_custom_ffmpeg
description:
Run a custom FFmpeg command for advanced use cases not covered by other tools.
The 'ffmpeg' prefix is optional - it will be added automatically if not present.

command.description: Full FFmpeg command string (e.g., "-i input.mp4 -vf reverse output.mp4")

name: get_ffmpeg_version
description:
Get FFmpeg version and build configuration info.

Returns:
    JSON string with version info

name: list_supported_formats
description:
List all file formats (muxers/demuxers) supported by the installed FFmpeg.

Returns:
    JSON string with supported formats

name: list_supported_codecs
description:
List all codecs (encoders/decoders) supported by the installed FFmpeg.

Returns:
    JSON string with supported codecs

name: reverse_video
description: Reverse a video (play backwards).

reverse_audio.description: Whether to also reverse the audio

name: create_mosaic
description: Create a video mosaic/grid from multiple video files.

input_paths.description: Comma-separated list of video file paths

output_path.description: Path for the output mosaic video
